text: At its meeting on September 24, 2019 the TTC Board considered a report, titled “Audit, Risk and Compliance: Progress and Strategies to Address Toronto Transit Commission’s High Priority Outstanding Recommendations from the Auditor General”. The TTC Board: 1. Received the report. 2. Approved forwarding a copy of the report to the Audit Committee. The foregoing is submitted to the Audit Committee for consideration.
The Audit Committee received this Item for information.
